svg.title: Literal multiplicative feedback encounters 450 impossible transitions
svg.desc: The LP2 transcription has 458 zero-index runes and 450 zero-to-nonzero transitions. The literal recurrence cannot leave zero.

g.text: LP2-00–55 · F is rune index 0 · page boundaries retained
Each zero → nonzero edge contradicts the uninterrupted recurrence.
